abi.return_contract: void; the body never writes EAX and every exit ends at RET 0x4

mechanics: return immediately and untouched when the category at +0x14 is null
return immediately and untouched when the text object at +0x18 is null
derive the slot count as ((end_8c - begin_88) >> 3), the eight byte category slot stride
call the visibility port 0x005c29c0 once per slot with the freshly reloaded category pointer
count visible slots into total and record selected as the running count when index == current_a0
when total < 2 call the nav vtable slot +0x7c with (1, 0) and return
when total >= 2 call the nav vtable slot +0x7c with (1, 1) before the label work
short circuit and return when the cached pair at +0x20/+0x24 already matches
format into a stack OpaqueTextBuffer initialised to the 0x01667bac scratch pair with end 0x01667bae
hand the formatted begin pointer to the text vtable slot +0x80
write the cached pair at +0x20 and +0x24 before the span gate
release the buffer through 0x00f47380 only when (end - begin) & 0xfffffffe exceeds 2 and begin is non null
